## Episode Thesis

This Friday panel on Börsmorgon features Patrik Wallén (chair of Volati and Bokusgruppen) and Johanna Jansson (co-founder of Kunskapsverket, formerly of Dagens Industri). They discuss the tight Swedish election polls and Swedish energy policy, where the guests criticise the electricity subsidies and state-owned Vattenfall's bonuses and advertising spend, and argue the state should sell holdings such as Vattenfall's market-exposed operations, SBAB and LKAB. They also cover EU regulatory burden and a thawing IPO market (SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Volati's spin-off of Salix on 15 June), which Wallén calls very discriminating and bubble-like at the top, but no listed stock gets an explicit buy or sell call.
